name: summit-asset-management
//: This machine runs Node 22.11. Vite 8 requires Node >=22.12, and npm therefore silently skips Vite 8's native rolldown binding, which breaks the build. Astro is pinned to 5.14.x (Vite 6) and vite is overridden tree-wide so @tailwindcss/vite cannot hoist a Vite 8 into the root. Remove the pin and the override once Node is upgraded past 22.12.
